scripts.build: npm run build:projects && npm run build:site
scripts.build:projects: npm run build --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-framework && npm run build --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-stories && npm run build:projects --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-pages && tsx scripts/build.ts && npm run typecheck:catalogue
scripts.build:site: npm run typecheck:framework && npm run typecheck:stories && npm run typecheck:self && npm run build:site --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-pages
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:framework && npm run typecheck:pages && npm run typecheck:stories && npm run typecheck:self && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:vrt
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:examples && npm run test:unit:framework && npm run test:unit:pages
scripts.clean:build: npm run clean:build --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-framework && npm run clean:build --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-stories && npm run clean:build --workspace=@porsche-design-system/examples-pages && rm -rf ./generated
